name: Impressive Monet & Brilliant Klimt
description: Step inside the masterpieces of two legendary artists. This new immersive experience projects their iconic works onto the walls of Alfândega do Porto for a breathtaking visual journey.
longDescription:
"Impressive Monet & Brilliant Klimt" is an art exhibition presented by Immersivus Gallery, located within Alfândega do Porto. This event utilizes large-scale digital projection technology to display the works of Claude Monet and Gustav Klimt, allowing viewers to engage with their art in an expansive, multi-sensory format. The exhibition focuses on presenting a selection of their renowned paintings in an immersive environment.

Visitors will encounter the projected artworks across the interior surfaces of the historic Alfândega do Porto building. The experience is designed to be a visual journey through the artistic styles and periods of both artists. The duration of the experience is not specified, but immersive exhibitions typically allow for self-paced viewing within a set timeframe. The venue itself is a notable historic building by the Douro River.

Ticketing information indicates that prices vary, suggesting different tiers or dates may have different costs. The Alfândega do Porto is situated near the riverfront, accessible by walking from central Porto, or via local bus routes. Specific public transport stops are not provided.
